title: The bird on the lamp on the sand
logline: Nine days after the Grunion Run: the green lamp left on the beach, unlit, standing in the sand where the lanterns were, and the bird on its shade. The tide out. Nobody came back for it yet.

panels.composition: A green swing-arm desk lamp standing unlit in beach sand by day, the small rainbow bird perched on its shade, the tide far out, lantern-post holes in the sand.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a green swing-arm desk lamp standing unlit in beach sand by day with a small rainbow bird perched on its shade, the tide far out and small holes in the sand where lantern posts stood, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: Left on the beach. The bird on it.
